dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Big Iron Chunk is no match for Nara {NICKNAME}, and Arama is no match for Vanagni.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #But during adventures with Nara {NICKNAME}, Arama will beat Big Iron Chunks someday.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: When Arama becomes stronger, Arabalika wants another match with Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Then Arabalika can continue the Ararakalari training, without leaving Vanarana.
